# create

Create and store authentication profiles on this computer

## Usage

```
ppds auth create [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--applicationId` | `-id` | `string` |  | Optional: The application ID to authenticate with |
| `--azureDevOpsFederated` | `-adof` | `bool` |  | Use Azure DevOps Federation for Service Principal Auth; requires --tenant and --applicationId arguments |
| `--certificateDiskPath` | `-cdp` | `string` |  | Optional: The certificate disk path to authenticate with |
| `--certificatePassword` | `-cp` | `string` |  | Optional: The certificate password to authenticate with |
| `--certificateThumbprint` | `-ct` | `string` |  | Certificate thumbprint for Windows certificate store authentication |
| `--clientSecret` | `-cs` | `string` |  | Optional: The client secret to authenticate with |
| `--cloud` | `-ci` | `CloudEnvironment` |  | Optional: The cloud instance to authenticate with |
| `--deviceCode` | `-dc` | `bool` |  | Use the Microsoft Entra ID Device Code flow for interactive sign-in |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Default environment (ID, url, unique name, or partial name) |
| `--githubFederated` | `-ghf` | `bool` |  | Use GitHub Federation for Service Principal Auth; requires --tenant and --applicationId arguments |
| `--managedIdentity` | `-mi` | `bool` |  | Use Azure Managed Identity |
| `--name` | `-n` | `string` |  | The name you want to give to this authentication profile (maximum 30 characters) |
| `--password` | `-p` | `string` |  | Optional: The password to authenticate with |
| `--tenant` | `-t` | `string` |  | Tenant ID if using application ID/client secret or application ID/client certificate |
| `--username` | `-un` | `string` |  | Optional: The username to authenticate with; shows a Microsoft Entra ID dialog if not specified |
